name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Michael Myerz
description: Step into Halloween with Michael Myerz, our newest limited-edition drop. Bursting with a bold, sweet flavor and a smooth finish, this strain-inspired treat delivers chills in the best way possible. Only available for a short time, Michael Myerz is crafted for those who like their Halloween with a little more edge — and a lot more flavor.
